Definition: {to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to give, provide; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to give; 1a2) to place, lay (foundations); 1b) (Hithp'al); 1b1) to be given; 1b2) to be paid
